subject: Request: headcount swap + payband uplift for ML Infra Lead
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: headcount swap + payband uplift for ML Infra Lead

Neha —

Quick summary: Rohan (ML Infra Lead) resigned effective 9/30; team proposes an internal transfer of Priya Natarajan (current IC4 ML Engineer) into the ML Infra Lead slot with an IC5 relevel and a payband uplift to match market for infra/ops leads. Markus notes below the rationale and asks for headcount/headcount-swap approval + comp uplift authorization so People Ops can extend an internal offer.

Why this path: Priya has been driving our KV-cache persistence project and owns our local serving infra. She has operational context, will minimize ramp, and keeps the calendar intact for our Q4 rollout. If we hire externally it will take 4-6 months and risk momentum.

Ask:
- Approve headcount swap (replace Rohan with Priya; no net new headcount)
- Approve relevel from IC4 -> IC5 and comp band uplift: see attached comp_band_request_Q3.xlsx and market_comp_report_sept2025.pdf
- Priority: internal offer go live by 9/18 so start date for new role can be 10/6

Attachments: role_description_ML_Infra_Lead.pdf, comp_band_request_Q3.xlsx, market_comp_report_sept2025.pdf

If you want, we can loop in Finance/Comp to confirm budget reallocation; otherwise we'll assume the cost can be absorbed in my team’s hiring wallet (we have a small buffer).

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: headcount swap + payband uplift for ML Infra Lead

Thanks Markus — quick clarifying Qs before I route formally to Comp/Finance:

1) Is this strictly a headcount swap (Rohan out, Priya into same headcount) or are you requesting an additional FTE for backfill of Priya’s IC4 role?
2) Confirm target total comp range you want authorized for Priya post-relevel (please show min/target/max and band name).
3) Has Priya expressed acceptance of an internal move in principle? We should have an initial verbal consent before we prepare an offer.

If you can confirm the three items I’ll prepare the formal packet for Compensation and loop in Finance.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, CompBench Sales <sales@compbench.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: headcount swap + payband uplift for ML Infra Lead

Neha — thanks. Answers inline below.

1) Headcount: this is a strict swap. No net-new headcount requested. The team will backfill Priya’s IC4 slot later in Q4 from open reqs; that will be a separate hiring ticket.

2) Target comp: we’re proposing band: Senior Infra Lead (Band E3). Requested range (USD, fully loaded):
- Min: $165,000
- Target: $195,000
- Max: $225,000
(See comp_band_request_Q3.xlsx for mapping to Redwood bands and market percentiles; market_comp_report_sept2025.pdf attached for benchmarks.)

3) Priya has given tentative verbal agreement to move into the role if the band matches the market/role expectations. She asked that we formalize the offer and include a note on promotion timeline and expectations in the JD.

Other notes: I’ve attached a short role_description_ML_Infra_Lead.pdf with updated expectations (includes ownership of serving runtime and on-call rotation). If Comp/Finance want more runway we can stage a mid-year uplift but prefer a one-time relevel for retention.

Markus

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: headcount swap + payband uplift for ML Infra Lead

Markus / Neha —

Thanks for the context. I’m supportive of the internal transfer and the rationale — keeping continuity on infra is important for Q4. My asks before I give final sign-off:

- Finance confirms budget reallocation (no new headcount).
- We document expectations and a 6-month success criteria for the promotion (total scope: team ownership, on-call, rollout oversight).
- Offer should include a clear promo timeline to IC5 responsibilities (we should avoid ambiguity).

If Finance confirms budget today/tomorrow I’m fine approving and asking People Ops to proceed with an internal offer.

Laura
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: headcount swap + payband uplift for ML Infra Lead

All —

Finance confirms: we can absorb the uplift within Markus’s FY25 hiring/comp pool by reprioritizing an open hiring hold on one of his non-critical reqs. That means no additional headcount or incremental funding required. Approved to move forward from a budget perspective.

Next steps (from Finance/People Ops):
- Neha: please prepare the formal internal offer. Use offer_template_ML_Lead.docx and include the following band guidance (Band E3, target $195k, bump effective 10/6).
- Priya: please confirm acceptance when Neha reaches out; include a short note about expectations and 6-month success criteria.
- Markus: create JIRA ENG-7342 to track the role transition and tasks; link doc folder.

I’ll drop into the Confluence page to confirm the budget note.

—Ava Chen
Finance Manager, People & Ops
Redwood Inference
